basics.name: MOUNIKA MULLUKUNTLA
basics.label: Full-Stack Developer | AI/ML Enthusiast
basics.summary:
Results driven software engineer with expertise in full - stack web development, Python, JavaScript UI development,
 database management, and web application architecture. Holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science with a
 concentration in Artificial Intellig ence and Machine Learning, demonstrating strong commitment to continuous
 learning and technical excellence. Passionate about building scalable web applications, automating complex processes,
 and leveraging AI/ML to solve real - world problems.

work.summary:
- Developed and maintained two enterprise web applications for retail/e - commerce operations and internal
 design/operations, managing the full software development lifecycle from requirements to production
 deployment.
 - Built modern, reusable frontend components using Python backed REST APIs with React, and Angular ensuring
 consistent state management and high - performance, responsive user interfaces.
 - Collaborated with cross - functional teams of developers, architects, and product managers to deliver solutions with
 minimal P0 defects and 100% alignment to customer requ irements across both projects.
 - Debugged and optimized application components, reducing page load latency from 10 seconds to 2 seconds
 through code splitting, lazy loading, and database query optimization, significantly enhancing user experience.
 - Modernized an internal design/operations platform by identifying outdated components and implementing
 microservices architecture, reducing maintenance overhead by 30% and improving scalability.
 - Delivered two critical web applications with real - time inventory updates, robust e - commerce functionality, and
 consistent design standards supporting 50+ internal teams, all completed on schedule with strong client
 satisfaction.
 - Applied Agile methodologies through sprint planning, daily standups, and iterative developme nt to deliver all
 releases with zero missed deadlines.
 - Resolved real - time production challenges including high - traffic e - commerce bottlenecks via CDN integration and
 caching, and cross - browser UI issues through modern CSS Grid/Flexbox implementations.
 - Crea ted technical specifications, deployment guides, and process documentation to facilitate knowledge transfer,
 accelerate debugging, and enable seamless team onboarding during client handovers.
 - Integrated both enterprise applications through unified Python R EST APIs and shared microservices layer,
 enabling seamless data synchronization between retail/e - commerce operations and internal design systems while
 maintaining independent deployment pipelines.

- Conducted code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions that improved team code quality by 25% and
 standardized development practices across projects.
